actions.name: move_to
actions.description: Track a fixed world-frame XYZ target in meters with fresh proprioceptive feedback every 20Hz control cycle. Defaults: 72 total cycles, 30 seconds, 20 consecutive cycles within tolerance_xyz=[0.006,0.006,0.008]m. No H1 required. Return a complete CommandReceipt dict, identical for move_to(...) and act('move_to', ...). Read receipt['result']['motion']['reached']; there is no top-level receipt['motion']. result.motion contains reached, reason, error_xyz, error_max_m, cycles, settled_cycles and elapsed_seconds. Unreached returns FAILED and aborts the policy before later stages. reached is control success, not lift success.

verifications.name: stack_objects
verifications.description: Verify red cube stacked on green cube, released, with official Stack success and low object velocities for 20 consecutive control cycles (1 simulation second).

metadata.control_cycle_budget: All motion/gripper cycles share this session limit; stop cleanup is separate. home/connect/arm do not refill it.
metadata.perception_contract: RGB-D: state.perception contains red-rgbd-v1 points (max 128), centroid, ok/count, metric world-z-up. Check ok before motion. end_effector_position is robot proprioception. delta_xyz is normalized per-step control (0.05 m scale), not a meter target. Stack adds state.support_perception: green-rgbd-v1 points and centroid of the green support cube, same camera/time/frame/units. Both clouds use RGB colors and aligned depth only. Task: release the red cube on top of the green cube, retreat and allow settling; verify stack_objects.
